div.div:
Relationship cardinality
One bar = exactly one (1)
Circle + bar = zero or one (0..1)
Circle + crow's foot = zero or many (0..N)
Dashed = nullable / loose reference

div.div: Repeated ownership links to USERS are written in each table box instead of being drawn across the canvas. The two wallet-transfer roles use separate corridors; BACKUP_CONFIG is shown explicitly as the sole 1:1 relationship. Fill colors distinguish profile/operations, deterministic ledger, planning/recurring and LLM-related data.
